entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Look, there's that bastard!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But his men are with him too.
entries.uk: Але з ним і його люди.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Exiting here will land us directly in front[n]of them. There will be no chance of[n]escape at that point.
entries.uk: Якщо вийдемо тут, опинимося просто[n]перед ними. Тоді втекти вже[n]не вийде.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What should we do, Joker?
Let's go.
We should hold off.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Very well. We shall jump in!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Indeed. Let us first prepare ourselves[n]somewhat better.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The cleaner and his men are in there.[n]Exiting from here will land us directly[n]in front of them.
entries.uk: Прибиральник і його люди там.[n]Якщо вийдемо тут, опинимося[n]просто перед ними.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: There will be no chance of escape[n]at that point... Are you ready?
entries.uk: Тоді втекти вже не вийде...[n]Ти готовий?

entries.speaker: Extremely Vulgar Man
entries.en: ...Whaddya want? You come lookin'[n]for trouble?
That's right.
Just hear us out.
Why do you say that?

entries.speaker: Extremely Vulgar Man
entries.en: I said you're off the hook, didn't I?[n]You got guts, bro.
entries.uk: Я ж казав, що відпускаю вас, хіба ні?[n]Сміливий ти, брате.

entries.speaker: Extremely Vulgar Man
entries.en: Shut it! This place is off-limits, moron!

entries.speaker: Extremely Vulgar Man
entries.en: Shut it! This place is off-limits, moron!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Crap, this guy might be just a cognition,[n]but he's damn scary!
entries.uk: Чорт, хай він лише когніція,[n]але страшний до жаху!

entries.speaker: Extremely Vulgar Man
entries.en: I'm too busy to deal with you punks now.[n]I'll be leavin' that to my men here.
entries.uk: Мені зараз не до вас, шмаркачі.[n]Лишаю вас на своїх хлопців.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Again? This better be the last time!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We did it! Now where is he!?
entries.uk: Ми впоралися! А де ж він!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Look, over there!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dammit, we're not lettin' him escape![n]Let's take that letter by force if we gotta!
entries.uk: Чорт, ми не дамо йому втекти![n]Заберемо лист силою, якщо доведеться!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait up! Hey! Listen, dammit!

entries.speaker: Extremely Vulgar Man
entries.en: You punks sure like to bark.[n]How annoying.
entries.uk: Ну й любите ви гавкати, шмаркачі.[n]Аж дратує.
